posts.name: Escher
posts.cooked:
Oh, I don’t remember the exact discussion – this was years ago, I think it was during the Kickstarter for the initial DE set. As I remember, there was a question about whether there would be a Young Legacy in the box, and Christopher said something along the lines of “After a lot of consideration we decided that she deserves her own deck”.

Iron Legacy’s nemesis badge kinda confirms that, though there’s a small possibility that Felicia could be a Legacy variant with a different icon. But as I remember one of the reasons they wanted to split the two Legacies up was because father/daughter teamups aren’t uncommon in the comics but that’s impossible when they share a deck.
